title: Did the Blue Tsunami Drown AIPAC? This Former Congressman Says No
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
He was a twice-elected Democratic Congressman before AIPAC took him down in
one of the most expensive House primaries in U.S. history. Now, he's using the
lessons he's learned to help elect Democrats across the United States, from
Zohran Mamdani to Abdul El-Sayed.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Yes, former New York Congressman and Squad member **Jamaal Bowman** discusses
all that and more in his new memoir,
_[UNpolishED](https://bookshop.org/p/books/unpolished/ba33df1936cb598e?ean=9798996770007)_.
He sat down with **Mehdi** to reflect on his book and the big Democratic
victories in the midterms, warning AIPAC **" is not going anywhere."**

**" They may not donate directly to candidates,"** he says, **" but they will
still invest in their number one issue, which is Israel's apartheid, Israel's
genocide, and Israel's occupation."**

So for Bowman, his work is far from over. He has his sights set on helping
elect a certain progressive Democratic president in 2028 - none other than
California Congressman Ro Khanna.

But what about Alexandria Ocasio-Crotez's potential presidential bid? Has he
turned his back on his Squad "sister"?
